_: The register of terms tmct coins or borrows that name a concept from a discipline.
One row per term: the area it belongs to, the verdict from PLAN_NORMATIVE.md, and the
authoritative source it traces to. Checked by `node scripts/term-inventory.mjs --register`:
every term must still occur in the tree, so a row cannot outlive the code it describes.
A term earns a row when it names a discipline's concept. `idx`, `rows` and `tail` do not.
verdict: aligned | map | extend | rename | drop | open
probe:   the literal string to look for; defaults to the term itself
